evidence.shows: SAF 1.9 Mt in 2025 = 0.6% of jet fuel; 2.4 Mt projected for 2026.

evidence.title: Cleaner jet fuel (MIT TR10 2025)
evidence.shows: Availability: Now; ~0.5% of jet fuel in 2024; EU/UK 2% mandate from 2025.

verdicts.reading: Robots trained with generative-AI methods (foundation models built from teleoperation, sensor and internet data) learn new tasks fast and are already in commercial use now (2025).
verdicts.mainstream_test: Routine use by at least 20% of the relevant industry: share of deployed industrial/service robots, or of robot-using firms, running foundation-model-trained control policies.
verdicts.reason: No public measure of the share of robots using generative-AI-trained policies exists.
